56:51.text: Then indeed you, O those astray

56:52.text: Will be eating from trees of zaqqūm

56:53.text: And filling with it your bellies

56:54.text: And drinking on top of it from scalding water.

56:55.text: And will drink as the drinking of thirsty camels.

56:56.text: That is their accommodation on the Day of Recompense.

56:57.text: We have created you, so why do you not believe?

56:58.text: Have you seen that which you emit?

56:59.text: Is it you who creates it, or are We the Creator?

56:60.text: We have decreed death among you, and We are not to be outdone

56:61.text: In that We will change your likenesses and produce you in that

56:62.text: And you have already known the first creation, so will you not remember?

56:64.text: Is it you who makes it grow, or are We the grower?

56:65.text: If We willed, We could make it
debris, and you would remain in wonder,

56:68.text: And have you seen the water that you drink?

56:69.text: Is it you who brought it down from the clouds, or is it We who bring it down?

56:70.text: If We willed, We could make it bitter, so why are you not grateful?

56:71.text: And have you seen the fire that you ignite?

56:72.text: Is it you who produced its tree, or are We the producer?

56:73.text: We have made it a reminder

56:74.text: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.

56:75.text: Then I swear by the setting of the stars,

56:76.text: And indeed, it is an oath - if you could know -
